# Superfun Games for News

> Superfun Games builds complete, whitelabel daily games that newsrooms can launch under their own brand. Every game ships finished: your logo, your colors, your domain, no development work required.

Superfun Games is a family game shop in Austin, Texas, founded by Clark and Angie Wimberly. Games can be taken off the shelf and rebranded, or designed from scratch for a specific newsroom. Puzzle production is AI assisted with a human editor approving everything that ships, which is what makes a daily cadence practical for a small team.

## Games for sale

- [FlipWords](https://superfun.games/forsale/flipwords/): Flip, flop, and swap your tiles to solve clues from all sides. A complete, whitelabel daily word game, ready to launch under your brand.
- [Links](https://superfun.games/forsale/links/): Each clue tees up the next, in this word puzzle with golf scoring. A complete, whitelabel daily game, ready to launch under your brand.
- [Texas Two Step](https://superfun.games/forsale/texas-two-step/): Twist your tiles to match the clues in this word game with Texas twang. A complete, whitelabel daily game, ready to launch under your brand.
